Bug_Title: NP: Non-virtual method call passes null for non-null parameter (NP_NULL_PARAM_DEREF_NONVIRTUAL)
Bug_Details:
A possibly-null value is passed to a non-null method parameter.
Either the parameter is annotated as a parameter that should
always be non-null, or analysis has shown that it will always be
dereferenced.
Bug_Explanation: The processString method expects a non-null String as a parameter, but it is called with null in the showBug method, causing a NullPointerException when trying to call the toUpperCase method on a null object.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case `testProcessStringWithNull` calls the `showBug` method of `NonNullParameterBug` class which triggers the bug by passing null to the `processString` method that expects a non-null String.

This violates the bug rule 'NP: Non-virtual method call passes null for non-null parameter'.
